issues.body: queue_snapshot() treats the page as authoritative once hasNextPage is false, but for each node it conditionally adds headCommit.oid only when truthy. If GitHub returns a partial node with headCommit null, oid absent, or a malformed oid, the function still returns a complete QueueSnapshot with that current head omitted. decide_stale_run() then sees an older run for that current group as absent and returns CANCEL; the immediate revalidation repeats the same omission and permits the mutation. This contradicts the documented fail-closed invariant that incomplete queue state must refuse rather than resemble an empty/partial queue.
issues.fix_hint: In queue_snapshot(), require every node's headCommit to be an object whose oid is a full 40-hex SHA (and reject malformed required entry structure with GhError) before constructing QueueSnapshot. Add a behavior test using a live run plus a queue node with null/missing/malformed headCommit and assert reap_stale_runs returns nonzero with no cancellation; include the same malformed response during revalidation to exercise the real mutation path.
issues.title: Malformed current queue entries can cause live runs to be cancelled

verdict.summary: The reap is not fully fail-closed when GraphQL returns a structurally complete page containing an entry with a missing or malformed headCommit. queue_snapshot() silently omits that entry's head from head_oids, so an unfinished run for the still-current group can be classified obsolete and cancelled. The tests cover absent pageInfo and null/truncated queues, but not incomplete entry objects. Round 1 reported no findings, so this newly identified major correctness/safety defect makes progress regressing.
